io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.recipes

Class ShapelessCustomRecipe

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.recipes.ShapelessCustomRecipe
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    CustomRecipe, org.bukkit.inventory.Recipe

    public class ShapelessCustomRecipe
extends java.lang.Object
implements CustomRecipe
    Represents a shapeless recipe with potentially multiple ingredients and multiple results, with a definable chance for each result to be produced.
